title: Postmortem INC-0001: payments elevated error rate
text:
# Postmortem INC-0001: payments elevated error rate
Severity: SEV3

## Summary
ext-paylynx had no alert of its own; symptoms appeared upstream.

## Impact
~2.4% of requests affected for 72 min

## Root cause
Paylynx processor outage on ext-paylyxn. Not caused by a change.

## Detection
Paged Payments via alerts.

## Resolution
@samuel mitigated by failover vendor using runbook RB-ext-01.

## Timeline (UTC)
- 2026-08-02T05:58:44Z start
- 2026-08-02T06:01:54Z detected
- 2026-08-02T07:13:55Z mitigated
- 2026-08-02T08:12:55Z resolved

## Action items
- PAY-101
- PAY-102
- PAY-103

## Lessons
- pre-scale before sale events

title: Postmortem INC-0002: search elevated error rate
text:
# Postmortem INC-0002: search elevated error rate
Severity: SEV2

## Summary
Service-mesh symptoms appeared upstream.

## Impact
Approximately 4.4% of requests affected for 48 minutes.

## Root cause
Change chg_000003 (service-mesh deploy v2.35.2 (new tax rounding)) authored by @claudine introduced a serialization format change on service-mesh.

## Detection
Paged Discovery via alerts.

## Resolution
@claudine mitigated the issue by performing a rollback using runbook RB-servic-01.

- 2026-08-02T15:38:43Z start

title: Postmortem INC-0004: checkout elevated error rate
text:
# Postmortem INC-0004: checkout elevated error rate
Severity: SEV3

## Summary
The pg-payments service had no alert of its own; symptoms instead appeared upstream.

## Impact
Approximately 3.2% of requests were affected for a duration of 61 minutes.

## Root cause
A TLS certificate expired on payments. This incident was not caused by a change.

## Detection
Checkout was paged via alerts.

## Resolution
@lauren mitigated the issue by renewing the certificate using runbook RB-pg-01.

## Timeline (UTC)
- 2026-08-06T20:37:25Z start
- 2026-08-06T20:40:37Z detected
- 2026-08-06T21:42:01Z mitigated
- 2026-08-06T22:23:01Z resolved

## Action items
- PAY-104
- PAY-105
- PAY-106

## Lessons
- keep runbook current

# Postmortem INC-0012: redis-session elevated error rate
Severity: SEV3
## Summary
redis-session symptoms appeared upstream.
## Impact

title: ADR-001: Adopt structured logging across Identity services
text:
# ADR-001: Adopt structured logging across Identity services
Status: accepted
Decider: @aguichard

## Context
Session needs a change: adopt structured logging across identity services.

## Decision
Adopt structured logging across Identity services.

## Options considered
- use a different datastore (rejected)
- add a cache layer (rejected)

## Consequences
simpler on-call

title: ADR-002: Adopt structured logging across Edge services
text:
# ADR-002: Adopt structured logging across Edge services

Status: accepted

Decider: @lennart

## Context

api-gateway needs a change: adopt structured logging across edge services.

## Decision

Adopt structured logging across Edge services.

## Options considered

- rewrite the service (rejected)
- do nothing (rejected)

## Consequences

lower latency, higher cost

title: ADR-003: Deprecate v1 endpoints of payments
text:
# ADR-003: Deprecate v1 endpoints of payments
Status: accepted
Decider: @lauren

## Context
Payments needs a change: deprecate v1 endpoints of payments.

## Decision
Deprecate v1 endpoints of payments.

## Options considered
- buy a vendor product (rejected)
- add more replicas (rejected)

## Consequences
More operational load for one quarter.
